Class PropertyButtonModel

java.lang.Object
  javax.swing.DefaultButtonModel
      javax.swing.JToggleButton.ToggleButtonModel
          jsesh.uiFramework.PropertyButtonModel
All Implemented Interfaces:
javax.swing.ButtonModel, java.awt.ItemSelectable, java.io.Serializable
public class PropertyButtonModel
extends javax.swing.JToggleButton.ToggleButtonModel

A model linking a button to an object's property. The button will be linked to a specific value of an object's property.

Makes heavy use of reflection.

Constructor Detail

PropertyButtonModel

public PropertyButtonModel(PropertyHolder target,
                           java.lang.String propertyName,
                           java.lang.Object propertyValue)
Create a model which will be linked to a specific value of an object's property.

The button will be selected when the property has the said value, and selecting the button will indeed set the property to this value.

Parameters:
target - the object whose value will control the model
propertyName - the object's property.
propertyValue - the value of the property which will sets this model to "selected". Must not be null.
